verdict.rationale: Evidence only confirms one-click export to "Web-based platforms" exists (godot-gh-1), but there is no documentation of WebGL vs WebGPU support specifics, payload/size optimization, or export quality; a community report even notes C# export to web doesn't work (godot-comm-6), undercutting the completeness of the web story. missing for 10: WebGPU-specific docs, payload/size guidance, confirmation that GDScript/C# web builds work reliably, independent hands-on corroboration of web export quality.
